finePrint.summary: A lifetime-deal buyer gets perpetual access only while the extension remains operational and publicly available.

quote.text: A "Lifetime License" or "One-Time Purchase" grants you a perpetual license to use the applicable AI Toolbox module (or every module, if you purchased All Access Lifetime) for as long as the Extension remains operational and publicly available.

finePrint.summary: All Access Lifetime also unlocks every new platform added in the future at no extra cost.

quote.text: The All Access Lifetime plan additionally unlocks every new platform we add to AI Toolbox in the future, at no extra cost.

finePrint.summary: The free plan is capped at 2 folders, limited pins/bookmarks, 10 prompts and 25 results per search.

quote.text: up to 2 folders, 2 pinned chats and bookmarks, 10 saved prompts, and 25 search results per query

finePrint.summary: Initial purchases can be refunded within 14 days unless the buyer used the service extensively.

quote.text: You may request a refund within 14 calendar days of your initial purchase, provided you have not used the service extensively during that period

finePrint.summary: Exporting more than 50 conversations total or 25 in one export voids the 14-day money-back guarantee.

quote.text: Exporting more than 50 conversations in total by any export method (a single conversation, a bulk or folder export, an export of search results, or the all-platforms archive), or more than 25 conversations in one export.

finePrint.summary: Renewal charges are excluded from the 14-day guarantee and are generally non-refundable.

quote.text: Renewal charges are not refundable. The 14-day money-back guarantee applies to your initial purchase only.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can change pricing at any time, though active subscriptions and lifetime holders are protected until renewal.

quote.text: We reserve the right to adjust pricing at any time.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can update the Terms at any time, with 14 days notice promised for material changes.

quote.text: We may update these Terms from time to time.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can suspend or terminate access for Terms violations, fraud, or misuse.

quote.text: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your access to the Extension if you violate these Terms, engage in fraudulent activity, or misuse the service.

finePrint.summary: If the product is discontinued entirely, buyers get advance notice and a full refund if within 12 months of purchase.

quote.text: If we ever discontinue AI Toolbox entirely, we will provide reasonable advance notice.

finePrint.summary: Free users get only best-effort support with a typical 48-hour response time.

quote.text: Free users: Support is provided on a best-effort basis with a typical response time of 48 hours.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime and All Access Lifetime buyers are promised top-priority support.

quote.text: Premium Lifetime and All Access Lifetime users: Top-priority support.

finePrint.summary: The regular subscription price is $9.99 per month for each single-platform module.

quote.text: The ChatGPT module is $9.99/month, the Gemini module is $9.99/month, the Claude module is $9.99/month, and the Grok module is $9.99/month.

finePrint.summary: The annual alternative costs $59 per module per year, showing the baseline for lifetime value.

quote.text: Annual$59 per module per year, billed once a year.

finePrint.summary: The normal single-module lifetime price is $99 one-time, versus $199 for All Access.

quote.text: Lifetime$99 one-time per module. Pays back in under 10 months at $9.99/month.

trials.claimQuote:
Lifetime access to AI Toolbox
- All future Premium Plan updates
- If Plan name changes, deal will be mapped to the new Plan name with all accompanying updates
trials.reasoning: The terms limit lifetime access to while the extension remains operational and publicly available, and allow the vendor to discontinue AI Toolbox entirely with notice.

exhibits.quote: for as long as the Extension remains operational and publicly available.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime is limited to while the extension remains operational and publicly available, not unconditional lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: If we ever discontinue AI Toolbox entirely, we will provide reasonable advance notice.
exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves the right to discontinue AI Toolbox entirely, which would end lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: Lifetime access includes all current features and all future updates for that module at no additional cost.
exhibits.argument: Vendor terms confirm lifetime licenses include all future updates at no extra cost.

trials.claim: Includes unlimited Library with 1,000+ expert prompts and unlimited custom saved prompts
trials.claimQuote:
Unlimited Library with 1,000+ expert prompts
- Unlimited Custom saved prompts with {{variable}} placeholders
trials.reasoning: Reviews confirm a prompt library and saved prompts exist, but no exhibit confirms they are unlimited or that the library contains 1,000+ prompts.

exhibits.quote: You cannot add a prompt in the middle of the chat or even at the end; you need to be at the start.
exhibits.argument: Saved prompts cannot be freely reused mid-chat, undermining unlimited custom saved prompts usefulness.

exhibits.quote: with usage limits including up to 2 folders, 2 pinned chats and bookmarks, 10 saved prompts, and 25 search results per query.
exhibits.argument: Base product caps saved prompts at 10, so unlimited prompts is not inherent and requires paid tier.

exhibits.quote: bulk export options (PDF, Markdown, JSON) and the built-in prompt library are incredibly well-thought-out for power users.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the built-in prompt library exists and works for power users.

exhibits.quote: I also love the "//" shortcut to quickly pull up my saved prompts!
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms saved prompts can be pulled up quickly with the shortcut.

trials.claim: Includes unlimited folders, pinning, bulk export, bulk delete and bulk archive
trials.claimQuote:
Unlimited Folders and subfolders
- Unlimited Pinning
- Unlimited Bulk export
- Unlimited Bulk delete
- Unlimited Bulk archive
trials.reasoning: The binding refund terms void money-back eligibility after exporting more than 50 conversations total or 25 in one export, materially limiting the promised unlimited bulk export.

exhibits.quote: But for some reason the extension just one day decided it had enough of storing them and removed them all.
exhibits.argument: Pinned and bookmarked chats were deleted by the extension, contradicting reliable unlimited pinning.

exhibits.quote: Exporting more than 50 conversations in total by any export method (a single conversation, a bulk or folder export, an export of search results, or the all-platforms archive), or more than 25 conversations in one export.
exhibits.argument: Bulk export beyond 25 in one export or 50 total voids money-back eligibility, limiting unlimited bulk export.

exhibits.quote: the ability to bulk export entire projects and folders into localized formats (TXT, Markdown, JSON, PDF) provides a necessary barrier against data loss.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms bulk export of projects and folders into multiple formats works.

trials.claimQuote:
License Tier 1: $59 (was $199)
- Lifetime access to AI Toolbox
- All future Premium Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The exhibits only show $59 is the vendor's regular annual per-module price; regular subscription pricing is not evidence about the deal-specific Tier 1 lifetime price, and no exhibit confirms that deal price.

exhibits.quote: Annual$59 per module per year, billed once a year.
exhibits.argument: $59 is the annual per-module subscription price, not a lifetime Tier 1 price.

exhibits.quote: Lifetime$99 one-time per module. Pays back in under 10 months at $9.99/month.
exhibits.argument: Actual lifetime cost is $99 per module, not $59, making the $59 lifetime claim misleading.

exhibits.quote: Each module (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Grok) has an Annual plan at $59 per year, billed once a year.
exhibits.argument: Vendor pricing confirms a $59 price point per module.

trials.claim: One extension works across four AI platforms
trials.claimQuote:
Use one extension for four AI platforms
Your AI chat history can feel like a graveyard of good ideas.
trials.reasoning: The vendor states the single Chrome extension works inside ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Grok; the pricing exhibits concern which plan unlocks which AI, not whether the one extension works across the four platforms.

exhibits.quote: Paid plans unlock one AI. Use more than one? All Access covers all four.
exhibits.argument: A single paid plan unlocks only one AI, so one purchase does not work across four platforms.

exhibits.quote: Every cross-platform feature comes with any paid plan when you use it from the AI your plan covers; All Access Lifetime unlocks them on all four AIs.
exhibits.argument: Cross-platform use on all four AIs requires All Access Lifetime, not one base extension.

exhibits.quote: AI Toolbox is a Chrome extension that adds folders, search, a prompt library, and conversation export, all inside ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Grok.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms one Chrome extension works inside all four AI platforms.

exhibits.quote: One extension for ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Grok. Trusted by 40,000+ users.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms one extension covers all four platforms.

trials.claim: Adds folders, full-text search, prompt chaining, and bulk export to ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini
trials.claimQuote: Bring folders, full-text search, prompt chaining, and bulk export to ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini
trials.reasoning: The platform-specific terms for Gemini and Claude list search and export but omit folders, prompt chaining, and bulk export, contradicting that all those features are added to each named platform.

exhibits.quote: Adds full-text search with date, role, and exact-match filters, export (TXT, Markdown, JSON, PDF), background sync, and keyboard shortcuts to Google Gemini.
exhibits.argument: Gemini module lists only search, export, sync and shortcuts with no folders, prompt chaining or bulk export.

exhibits.quote: Adds full-text search with exact match, bookmarks, export (TXT, JSON), multi language UI (10+ locales with RTL support), and background sync to Claude.
exhibits.argument: Claude module lists only search, bookmarks and basic export with no folders, prompt chaining or bulk export.

exhibits.quote: Adding folders, full-text search, prompt management, bookmarks, exports and prompt chaining across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok addresses real limitations in the native platforms.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms folders, search, exports and prompt chaining work across the platforms.

exhibits.quote: with organizational tools including folders, subfolders, pinned chats, bookmarks, prompt management, prompt chaining, bulk actions, media gallery, audio download, usage tracking, search, export
exhibits.argument: Vendor terms list folders, prompt chaining, bulk actions, search and export as included tools.

themes.summary: Several buyers report severe slowdowns, high memory/CPU use, unfinished syncing/indexing and lost pins or folders.

hits.quote: Disappointing experience due to constant glitches and slowness
it can take nearly 10 seconds just to type a single character in the chat
Made my chrome slower and didn't even provide full access even after around 20 days of purchase
Some platforms never finish indexing (ChatGPT in my case), making them unusable for cross-searching
when you make folders and refresh your page more often, the folders are not completely loaded
Deducting 1 taco because removing the Gemini watermark on images is a hit-or-miss

themes.summary: Many buyers say support fixed licensing and sync issues quickly, often within an hour or on a Sunday.

hits.quote: I contacted support on a Sunday and they fixed it immediately — excellent service
their support desk provided immediate, precise technical instructions to rebuild the index without resorting to scripted deflection
They resolve issues, they don't just make promises, and they do so in under an hour
but the support team sorted it out so quickly and easily that I was really pleasantly surprised
The support team responded to my email very quickly, and with their help, I was able to resolve several problems
Fortunately, their customer support was fast and fixed my email address

themes.summary: Many buyers say cross-platform search, folders, and bulk export work well and improve productivity.

hits.quote: Being able to categorize my projects, pin important conversations, and use smart tags has saved me so much time
I export the whole conversation and use its context transfer feature
well, the name says it all. it works well for me
searches are lightning-fast, and exporting large quantities of documents, files and images runs smoothly
